Update: 2 new images, all new stuff will be at the end.

Most of lewlem illustrations. most in full quality uncensored! some of their very early works have been lost to time so i was only able to acquire the lower res baraag versions. i recovered some of the full res images from a gallery from here and various sites on the internet.

I also included what lewlem posted to paheal and when they replaced their low res and censored images with the full res on their baraag. these have been replaced again with low res images by the artist so good thing i got them. there are some dubs that i'll clean up someday but over all its organized and pretty clean.

I do have permission to post the archive that lewlem handed off to me here. and i know its not all of it. this gallery is mostly to get the full quality uncensored stuff out there.

If you have any of their early works that are in their original resolution from pixiv. let me know in the comments! baraag was unfortunately very destructive when it came to preservation in the early years.
